selection.ordering: top3 delta_phi descending; then top3 rho_jump descending; lexical case ID ties; unique recorded episode

classification_rules.both_dwells: safe valid method with both observed, never cap-imputed
classification_rules.graph_specific: valid/safe V2 both; either simpler methods both fail BOTH_DWELLS, or >=one-tick earlier attachment than BOTH and endpoint no later than BOTH
classification_rules.regression: V2 unsafe while B/H planning valid; V2 guard abort while neither B/H aborts; V2 loses attachment or endpoint retained by both safe valid B/H; shared failure suppresses regression
classification_rules.staging: nonempty evaluable set; all B_ENTRY both dwells; graph positive count exactly zero
classification_rules.robustness: at least two V2 invalid/nonconverged with BOTH B_ENTRY/Hermite valid safe full-cap executions; after staging in precedence
classification_rules.shared_failure: all four methods terminate SAFETY_ABORT_BEFORE_UNSAFE_COMMAND; exclude from evaluable denominator and V2 regression
classification_rules.catastrophic_regression: V2-specific unsafe reference, attributable guard abort, or endpoint loss retained by both B/H; attachment loss separately reported

source_policy.timing: reuse raw acquisition interval timing gates from genuine source scan
source_policy.d_F: median [E*, original suffix] XY edges, including first partial edge
source_policy.minimum_suffix_rows_reason: E* plus >=4 downstream rows; full H5 spatial content at entry
source_policy.episode_exclusion: exact recorded episode including repeat; GP01 REF03 Genuine13 execution development and ATTACH01; plus whole previous E1-E6 episodes
source_policy.direction_degeneracy: <=1e-12 m, same frozen bridge EPS; no reliability threshold tuning
source_policy.claim: source-disjoint saved DEVELOPMENT corpus controlled evaluation; not unseen independent population
